        "arguments": "{\"filePath\": \"src/util/event-bus/middleware.ts\", \"content\": \"/**\\n * EventBus 中间件工具函数\\n * 提供常用中间件工厂函数\\n */\\n\\nimport type { Middleware, EventContext } from './types';\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建日志中间件\\n * 记录事件开始和完成，不传播错误\\n */\\nexport function createLoggingMiddleware(source?: string): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\n    console.log(`[${source || 'EventBus'}] Event started: ${context.event}`, {\\n      correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n      timestamp: new Date(context.metadata.timestamp).toISOString(),\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      await next();\\n      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      console.log(`[${source || 'EventBus'}] Event completed: ${context.event}`, {\\n        correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n        duration: `${duration}ms`,\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      console.error(`[${source || 'EventBus'}] Event failed: ${context.event}`, {\\n        correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n        duration: `${duration}ms`,\\n        error,\\n      });\\n      // 错误已被EventBus记录，不重新抛出\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建错误处理中间件\\n * 核心：捕获错误，调用回调，不向调用方抛出\\n */\\nexport function createErrorHandlingMiddleware(\\n  onError?: (error: Error, context: EventContext) => void\\n): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    try {\\n      await next();\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      if (onError) {\\n        onError(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), context);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建验证中间件\\n * 验证失败时抛出错误（验证错误是预期的，不应被吞掉）\\n */\\nexport function createValidationMiddleware<T>(\\n  validator: (data: T) => boolean | Promise<boolean>,\\n  errorMessage = 'Validation failed'\\n): Middleware<T> {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    const isValid = await validator(context.data);\\n    if (!isValid) {\\n      throw new Error(`${errorMessage} for event: ${context.event}`);\\n    }\\n    await next();\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建超时中间件\\n * 超时时中止事件，不抛出错误到调用方\\n */\\nexport function createTimeoutMiddleware(timeoutMs: number): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;\\n    let timedOut = false;\\n\\n    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {\\n      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {\\n        timedOut = true;\\n        context.abort();\\n        resolve(); // 不抛出错误，只中止\\n      }, timeoutMs);\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      await Promise.race([next(), timeoutPromise]);\\n    } finally {\\n      if (timeoutId) {\\n        clearTimeout(timeoutId);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建重试中间件\\n * 重试用尽后记录错误，不抛出到调用方\\n */\\nexport function createRetryMiddleware(\\n  maxRetries: number,\\n  delayMs: number = 1000\\n): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    let attempt = 0;\\n    let lastError: Error | undefined = undefined;\\n\\n    while (attempt <= maxRetries) {\\n      try {\\n        await next();\\n        return; // 成功则返回\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        lastError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\\n        attempt++;\\n\\n        if (attempt <= maxRetries) {\\n          const backoffMs = delayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);\\n          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, backoffMs));\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    // 重试次数用完，错误已被EventBus记录，不抛出\\n  };\\n}\\n\"}"

        "arguments": "{\"filePath\": \"src/util/event-bus/middleware.ts\", \"content\": \"/**\\n * EventBus 中间件工具函数\\n * 提供常用中间件工厂函数\\n */\\n\\nimport type { Middleware, EventContext } from './types';\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建日志中间件\\n * 记录事件开始和完成，不传播错误\\n */\\nexport function createLoggingMiddleware(source?: string): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\n    console.log(`[${source || 'EventBus'}] Event started: ${context.event}`, {\\n      correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n      timestamp: new Date(context.metadata.timestamp).toISOString(),\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      await next();\\n      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      console.log(`[${source || 'EventBus'}] Event completed: ${context.event}`, {\\n        correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n        duration: `${duration}ms`,\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      console.error(`[${source || 'EventBus'}] Event failed: ${context.event}`, {\\n        correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n        duration: `${duration}ms`,\\n        error,\\n      });\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建错误处理中间件\\n * 核心：通过onError回调捕获处理器错误，调用回调，不向调用方抛出\\n */\\nexport function createErrorHandlingMiddleware(\\n  onError?: (error: Error, context: EventContext) => void\\n): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    // 设置错误回调，捕获处理器中的错误\\n    context.onError = (error: Error) => {\\n      if (onError) {\\n        onError(error, context);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      await next();\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      // 中间件本身的错误\\n      if (onError) {\\n        onError(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), context);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建验证中间件\\n * 验证失败时抛出错误（验证错误是预期的）\\n */\\nexport function createValidationMiddleware<T>(\\n  validator: (data: T) => boolean | Promise<boolean>,\\n  errorMessage = 'Validation failed'\\n): Middleware<T> {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    const isValid = await validator(context.data);\\n    if (!isValid) {\\n      throw new Error(`${errorMessage} for event: ${context.event}`);\\n    }\\n    await next();\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建超时中间件\\n * 超时时中止事件，不抛出错误到调用方\\n */\\nexport function createTimeoutMiddleware(timeoutMs: number): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;\\n    let timedOut = false;\\n\\n    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {\\n      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {\\n        timedOut = true;\\n        context.abort();\\n        resolve();\\n      }, timeoutMs);\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      await Promise.race([next(), timeoutPromise]);\\n    } finally {\\n      if (timeoutId) {\\n        clearTimeout(timeoutId);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建重试中间件\\n * 重试用尽后记录错误，不抛出到调用方\\n */\\nexport function createRetryMiddleware(\\n  maxRetries: number,\\n  delayMs: number = 1000\\n): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    let attempt = 0;\\n    let lastError: Error | undefined = undefined;\\n\\n    while (attempt <= maxRetries) {\\n      try {\\n        await next();\\n        return;\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        lastError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\\n        attempt++;\\n\\n        if (attempt <= maxRetries) {\\n          const backoffMs = delayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);\\n          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, backoffMs));\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\"}"

    }

        "arguments": "{\"content\": \"/**\\n * EventBus 中间件工具函数\\n * 提供常用中间件工厂函数\\n *\\n * 设计原则：\\n * 1. 日志中间件：记录事件开始和完成\\n * 2. 错误处理中间件：通过 onError 回调捕获错误\\n * 3. 验证中间件：验证失败时中止事件\\n * 4. 超时中间件：超时后中止事件\\n * 5. 重试中间件：自动重试失败的操作\\n */\\n\\nimport type { Middleware, EventContext } from './types';\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建日志中间件\\n * 记录事件开始和完成\\n */\\nexport function createLoggingMiddleware(source?: string): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\n    const sourceLabel = source || 'EventBus';\\n\\n    console.log(`[${sourceLabel}] Event started: ${context.event}`, {\\n      correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n      timestamp: new Date(context.metadata.timestamp).toISOString(),\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      await next();\\n      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      console.log(`[${sourceLabel}] Event completed: ${context.event}`, {\\n        correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n        duration: `${duration}ms`,\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      console.error(`[${sourceLabel}] Event failed: ${context.event}`, {\\n        correlationId: context.metadata.correlationId,\\n        duration: `${duration}ms`,\\n        error,\\n      });\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建错误处理中间件\\n * 通过 onError 回调捕获处理器错误\\n */\\nexport function createErrorHandlingMiddleware(\\n  onError?: (error: Error, context: EventContext) => void\\n): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    context.onError = (error: Error) => {\\n      if (onError) {\\n        onError(error, context);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    try {\\n      await next();\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      if (onError) {\\n        onError(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), context);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建验证中间件\\n * 验证失败时中止事件\\n */\\nexport function createValidationMiddleware<T>(\\n  validator: (data: T) => boolean | Promise<boolean>,\\n  errorMessage = 'Validation failed'\\n): Middleware<T> {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    const isValid = await validator(context.data);\\n    if (!isValid) {\\n      throw new Error(`${errorMessage} for event: ${context.event}`);\\n    }\\n    await next();\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建超时中间件\\n * 超时后中止事件\\n */\\nexport function createTimeoutMiddleware(timeoutMs: number): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;\\n\\n    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {\\n      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {\\n        context.abort();\\n        resolve();\\n      }, timeoutMs);\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      await Promise.race([next(), timeoutPromise]);\\n    } finally {\\n      if (timeoutId) {\\n        clearTimeout(timeoutId);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 创建重试中间件\\n * 自动重试失败的操作（指数退避）\\n */\\nexport function createRetryMiddleware(\\n  maxRetries: number,\\n  delayMs: number = 1000\\n): Middleware {\\n  return async (context, next) => {\\n    let attempt = 0;\\n    let lastError: Error | undefined = undefined;\\n\\n    while (attempt <= maxRetries) {\\n      try {\\n        await next();\\n        return;\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        lastError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\\n        attempt++;\\n\\n        if (attempt <= maxRetries) {\\n          const backoffMs = delayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);\\n          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, backoffMs));\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n}\\n\", \"filePath\": \"/Users/wrr/work/ai-agent-v2/src/util/event-bus/middleware.ts\"}"

  "content": "<think>\n让我创建一个完整的示例，展示如何使用静默模式。\n</think>\n\n## ✅ Agent 静默模式支持完成！\n\n### 新增的事件类型\n\n```typescript\ninterface AgentEvents {\n  // 原有事件...\n  \n  // 新增：日志事件（静默模式下使用）\n  'log': { level: 'info' | 'warn' | 'error'; message: string };\n  // 新增：开始思考事件\n  'thinking': { step: number };\n  // 新增：思考结束事件\n  'thinking-end': { step: number; hasToolCalls: boolean };\n  // 新增：工具调用组开始事件\n  'tool-calls-start': { count: number };\n  // 新增：工具调用组结束事件\n  'tool-calls-end': { count: number; hasErrors: boolean; summary: string };\n  // 新增：任务完成事件\n  'complete': { response: AgentResponse };\n  // 新增：任务取消事件\n  'cancelled': { reason: string };\n}\n```\n\n### 使用示例\n\n```typescript\nimport { Agent } from './agent';\n\nconst agent = new Agent({ llmProvider, systemPrompt });\n\n// 完全静默模式 - 所有输出由外部控制\nagent.events.on('thinking', ({ step }) => {\n  process.stdout.write(`\\r思考中 (${step})...`);\n});\n\nagent.events.on('stream-chunk', (chunk) => {\n  process.stdout.write(chunk.content || '');\n});\n\nagent.events.on('tool-call', ({ toolName, args }) => {\n  console.log(`\\n🔧 调用工具: ${toolName}`);\n});\n\nagent.events.on('complete', ({ response }) => {\n  console.log('\\n完成:', response.content);\n});\n\n// 启用静默模式\nawait agent.run('Hello', { silent: true });\n```\n\n### 事件流图\n\n```\n用户输入\n    ↓\n[message] 用户消息\n    ↓\nThinking-1...\n    ↓\n[thinking]  step: 1\n    ↓\nLLM 生成\n    ↓\n[stream-chunk] 流式输出\n    ↓\n[thinking-end]  hasToolCalls: false\n    ↓\n[complete] 响应完成\n```\n\n### 模式对比\n\n| 模式 | 用法 | 控制权 |\n|------|------|--------|\n| **默认模式** | `run('Hello')` | Agent 内部控制输出 |\n| **静默模式** | `run('Hello', { silent: true })` | 外部通过事件完全控制 |\n| **混合模式** | 监听部分事件 | 部分自定义，部分默认 |",

-------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    // 公开属性\\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    public readonly -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    // 构造函数\\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n\\n    constructor(config: DEFAULT_NO_PROGRESS_LIMIT);\\n\\n        // 初始化上下文\\n        this.context = getAgentContext({\\n            session: {\\n                sessionId: config.sessionId || `session_${Date.now()}`,\\n this.sessionManager.maxOutputTokens = Math.min(config.maxOutputTokens ?? providerMaxOutput, providerMaxOutput);\\n        this.sessionManager.maxTokens = Math.min(config.maxTokens ?? providerMaxTokens, providerMaxTokens);\\n\\n        // 初始化上下文压缩器\\n        this.compaction = new Compaction({\\n            maxTokens: this.sessionManager.maxTokens,\\n            maxOutputTokens: Promise<AgentResponse | null> {\\n        const runContext = new RunContext(this, options);\\n\\n        // 添加用户消息\\n        const userMessage: Message = { role: 'user', type: 'text', content: query };\\n        this.sessionManager.addMessage(userMessage);\\n        this.events.emit('message', { message: userMessage });\\n\\n        // 主循环\\n        let step = 0;\\n        while (true) {\\n            step++;\\n\\n            // 检查循环限制\\n            if (this.maxLoop && this.maxLoop > 0 && step > this.maxLoop) {\\n                return runContext.complete(`Max loop limit reached (${this.maxLoop})`);\\n            }\\n\\n            // 获取并压缩消息\\n            const messages = this.sessionManager.getMessages();\\n            const { totalUsed, usableLimit } = this.compaction.getToken(\\n                [{ role: 'system', content: this.systemPrompt }, ...messages],\\n                runContext.tools\\n            );\\n            runContext.log('info', `totalUsed: ${totalUsed}/${usableLimit}`);\\n\\n            const { isCompacted, list: llmMessages } = await this.compaction.compact(\\n                [{ role: 'system', content: this.systemPrompt }, ...messages],\\n                runContext.tools\\n            );\\n\\n            if (isCompacted) {\\n                this.sessionManager.setMessages(llmMessages);\\n            }\\n\\n            // 发送思考开始事件\\n            this.events.emit('thinking', { step });\\n\\n            try {\\n                const response = await this.executeStep(runContext, step, llmMessages);\\n                if (response !== null) {\\n                    return response;\\n                }\\n            } catch (error) {\\n                const handled = runContext.handleError(error, step);\\n                if (!handled) {\\n                    throw error;\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    // 私有方法\\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n\\n    /**\\n     * 执行单步思考\\n     */\\n    private async executeStep(\\n        runContext: RunContext,\\n        step: number,\\n        messages: Message[]\\n    ): Promise<AgentResponse | null> {\\n        const { streamEnabled, streamCallback, abortSignal } = runContext;\\n        const spinner = abortController.signal;\\n\\n        if (abortSignal) {\\n            abortSignal.addEventListener('abort', () => abortController.abort());\\n        }\\n\\n        // 构建流式回调\\n        const wrappedStreamCallback = this.buildStreamCallback(runContext, spinner, streamCallback);\\n\\n        // 调用 LLM\\n        const llmResponse = await this.llmProvider.generate(\\n            [{ role: 'system', content: this.systemPrompt }, ...messages],\\n            {\\n                model: process.env.AI_MODEL,\\n                tools: runContext.tools.length > 0 ? runContext.tools : undefined,\\n                max_tokens: this.sessionManager.maxOutputTokens,\\n                stream: streamEnabled,\\n                streamCallback: wrappedStreamCallback,\\n                abortSignal: currentAbortSignal,\\n            }\\n        );\\n\\n        if (!llmResponse) {\\n            throw new Error('LLM response is null');\\n        }\\n\\n        // 保存 LLM 响应\\n        this.sessionManager.addMessage(llmResponse);\\n        this.events.emit('message', { message: llmResponse });\\n\\n        // 处理工具调用\\n        const { hasToolCalls, hasError } = await ToolError({\\n                role: 'tool',\\n                type: 'text',\\n                content: 'Error: Tool name is empty',\\n                tool_call_id: toolCall.id,\\n            });\\n        }\\n\\n        this.events.emit('tool-call', { toolName: name, args });\\n\\n        const startTime = Date.now();\\n        try {\\n            const result = await ToolRegistry.execute(name, this.events.emit('tool-result', {\\n                toolName: name,\\n                result: { success: false, error: errorMsg },\\n                duration,\\n            });\\n\\n            throw            });\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    /**\\n     * 处理工具调用\\n     */\\n    private async handleToolCalls(\\n        llmResponse: LLMResponse,\\n        runContext: RunContext\\n    ): Promise<{ true;\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        this.sessionManager.addMessage(toolResults);\\n        toolResults.forEach(msg => this.events.emit('message', { message: msg
